dialogues.speaker: Trapeznikov
dialogues.text: Ah, it's a famous rumor. During his reign, he tasked a mysterious organization with excavating technological artifacts from the Shadow Realm and putting them to use.

dialogues.speaker: Trapeznikov
dialogues.text: Word is, those excavations haven't stopped to this day. The only difference is that it's now driven entirely by the ambition of certain rogue factions.
